Title: Create document from preset size
Steps: 1) Choose preset 1920x1080 2) Click Create
Expected Result: Blank canvas of exactly 1920x1080 px opens; title shows 'Untitled'

Title: Custom size boundary values
Steps: 1) Enter 1x1 2) Create 3) Repeat with max allowed size and max+1
Expected Result: Min and max accepted; max+1 rejected with a clear message; no crash or freeze

Title: Reject invalid size input
Steps: 1) Enter 0, -50, 'abc', empty and 12.5 in width 2) Click Create
Expected Result: Invalid values rejected or sanitised; Create disabled or error shown; no blank/NaN canvas

Title: Save and reopen preserves content
Preconditions: Document with shapes, text and 2 layers
Steps: 1) Save 2) Close 3) Reopen file
Expected Result: All objects, layer order, names and visibility are identical to before saving

Title: Recover unsaved work after forced close
Steps: 1) Draw 5 objects 2) Kill the tab/app 3) Relaunch
Expected Result: Recovery prompt offers the unsaved session; restored content matches last edit

Title: Pen draws continuous stroke in chosen color
Steps: 1) Pick red 2) Drag a curve across the canvas
Expected Result: Smooth continuous red stroke follows the cursor path without gaps

Title: Brush size minimum and maximum
Steps: 1) Set size to minimum 2) Draw 3) Set to maximum 4) Draw
Expected Result: Min size is visible (not zero-width); max size draws without clipping or lag; slider bounds enforced

Title: Fast strokes leave no gaps
Steps: 1) Draw very fast zig-zags and circles
Expected Result: Stroke stays continuous and smooth; no dotted segments or sharp artifacts

Title: Eraser removes only targeted area
Steps: 1) Select eraser 2) Drag across part of a shape
Expected Result: Only the touched area is erased; neighbouring objects unchanged; eraser size matches the slider

Title: Fill bucket respects boundaries and antialiased edges
Steps: 1) Select fill 2) Click inside the shape
Expected Result: Fill stays inside the boundary; no unfilled halo along antialiased edges; no leak outside

Title: Switch tool while drawing
Steps: 1) Press mouse and drag 2) Press a tool shortcut mid-stroke 3) Release
Expected Result: Current stroke completes or cancels cleanly; no stuck tool state or ghost stroke

Title: Rectangle in all four drag directions
Steps: 1) Drag top-left to bottom-right 2) Repeat bottom-right to top-left, top-right to bottom-left, bottom-left to top-right
Expected Result: A rectangle is created each time with the correct size and position

Title: Constrain to square/circle with Shift
Steps: 1) Hold Shift and drag in each direction
Expected Result: Exact square / circle (equal width and height) in every direction

Title: Ellipse from center with Alt/Option
Steps: 1) Hold Alt and drag
Expected Result: Ellipse grows symmetrically from the click point

Title: Zero-size drag creates no broken shape
Steps: 1) Click without dragging 2) Drag 1 px
Expected Result: No invisible/zero-size object is left in the layer list or history; or a minimum size is applied consistently

Title: Corner radius limits
Steps: 1) Set radius to 0, 50, very large, negative
Expected Result: Radius clamps to half the shortest side; negative rejected; render matches value

Title: Stroke and fill toggle combinations
Steps: 1) Toggle fill on/off 2) Toggle stroke on/off 3) Turn both off
Expected Result: Each combination renders correctly; both-off shows a clear indicator or is prevented

Title: Single and multi-select
Steps: 1) Click one 2) Shift-click another 3) Marquee-select all
Expected Result: Selection handles and layer panel highlight match what is selected

Title: Nudge with arrow keys
Steps: 1) Press arrow keys 2) Hold Shift and press arrows
Expected Result: Moves 1 px (10 px with Shift) in the correct direction; undo reverts each move

Title: Resize with handles, aspect lock
Steps: 1) Drag a corner handle 2) Repeat with Shift held
Expected Result: Free resize without Shift; aspect ratio kept with Shift; no flip glitch when crossing the opposite edge

Title: Rotate with angle snapping
Steps: 1) Drag rotate handle 2) Hold Shift
Expected Result: Free rotation; snaps to 15 degree steps with Shift; angle readout matches

Title: Flip horizontal and vertical
Steps: 1) Flip H 2) Flip V 3) Flip H again
Expected Result: Shape mirrors correctly; double flip returns to original

Title: Align and distribute three objects
Steps: 1) Select all 2) Align left, center, right 3) Distribute horizontally
Expected Result: Edges/centers align exactly; gaps are equal after distribute

Title: Group and ungroup retain transforms
Steps: 1) Group 2) Move/scale group 3) Ungroup
Expected Result: Children keep relative position and appearance; ungroup does not reset rotation or size

Title: Add, rename and delete layer
Steps: 1) Add layer 2) Rename 3) Delete
Expected Result: Layer appears at the top; name persists; delete removes its objects and is undoable

Title: Reorder layers changes stacking
Steps: 1) Drag top layer below the other
Expected Result: Canvas stacking changes immediately and matches the panel order

Title: Hide, show and lock behavior
Steps: 1) Hide layer 2) Show 3) Lock 4) Try to draw/select on locked layer
Expected Result: Hidden layer not rendered or exported; locked layer cannot be edited; clear feedback is given

Title: Layer opacity 0, 50 and 100
Preconditions: Layer with filled shape over another
Steps: 1) Set opacity to 0, 50, 100
Expected Result: Visual result matches value; 0 is fully transparent but object remains selectable in panel

Title: Blend mode Multiply renders per spec
Steps: 1) Set top layer to Multiply
Expected Result: Result matches expected Multiply color math within tolerance and in export

Title: Merge layers preserves appearance
Steps: 1) Merge down 2) Compare before/after
Expected Result: Merged result is visually identical; undo restores separate layers

Title: Hex input valid and invalid values
Steps: 1) Enter #FFF, #FFFFFF, ffffff, #ZZZ, #12
Expected Result: Valid formats (incl. 3-digit shorthand) accepted and normalised; invalid rejected without changing current color

Title: Eyedropper samples across layers
Steps: 1) Eyedropper on an overlap 2) Check resulting color
Expected Result: Samples the composite or selected-layer color as documented; hex matches the screen pixel

Title: Alpha value matches rendering
Steps: 1) Set alpha 0, 25, 50, 100 2) Compare to background
Expected Result: Rendered transparency matches the number shown; 0 is invisible and 100 is opaque

Title: Save and reuse swatches
Steps: 1) Add swatch 2) Reload app 3) Click swatch
Expected Result: Swatch persists across sessions and applies the exact color

Title: Create and edit text
Steps: 1) Click canvas 2) Type 3) Change font and size 4) Edit again
Expected Result: Text appears where clicked; changes apply live; re-edit keeps content

Title: Unicode, emoji and RTL (Arabic) text
Steps: 1) Type Arabic, mixed Arabic/English, emoji and accented characters
Expected Result: Glyphs render with correct shaping and right-to-left order; cursor and selection behave correctly

Title: Missing font fallback
Preconditions: File using a font not installed
Steps: 1) Open the file
Expected Result: Fallback font used with a visible notice; layout does not break

Title: Very long text overflow
Steps: 1) Paste 5,000 characters
Expected Result: Text wraps or scrolls per spec; no freeze; bounding box updates

Title: Undo and redo mixed actions
Steps: 1) Undo each step to the start 2) Redo each step back
Expected Result: Each step reverts and restores exactly one action in the right order

Title: Redo cleared after a new action
Steps: 1) Undo twice 2) Draw something new 3) Press redo
Expected Result: Redo is unavailable after a new action; old redo steps are discarded

Title: Undo after clear or delete-all
Steps: 1) Click Clear 2) Press undo
Expected Result: All objects return exactly as before Clear

Title: History depth limit
Steps: 1) Perform 200 actions 2) Undo repeatedly
Expected Result: Documented limit enforced; oldest steps dropped gracefully; no crash

Title: Zoom controls and fit-to-screen
Steps: 1) Zoom via shortcut, wheel and menu 2) Use Fit to screen
Expected Result: Zoom level readout matches; fit shows the full document; limits enforced

Title: Drawing accuracy at 800% and 12% zoom
Steps: 1) Draw a line between two guide points at each zoom
Expected Result: Stroke lands exactly under the cursor; coordinates stay consistent after zooming back

Title: Pan with space+drag and scroll
Steps: 1) Hold Space and drag 2) Use scrollbars/trackpad
Expected Result: Smooth panning in all directions; cannot pan infinitely off the canvas

Title: PNG export background
Steps: 1) Export PNG with 'transparent' off 2) Export with it on 3) Open both
Expected Result: Off = solid background color (white by default); on = true alpha; both match the canvas

Title: JPG, SVG and PDF fidelity
Steps: 1) Export each format 2) Compare against canvas
Expected Result: Colors, positions, fonts and layer visibility match; hidden layers are excluded

Title: Export scale 1x and 2x
Steps: 1) Export at 1x and 2x
Expected Result: Pixel dimensions are 1000x500 and 2000x1000; no blur from resampling

Title: Import valid, large and corrupted files
Preconditions: Sample PNG, SVG, 50 MB image, truncated file
Steps: 1) Import each
Expected Result: Valid files import at correct size; large file handled with progress or limit message; corrupted file shows an error without crashing

Title: Documented shortcuts work
Steps: 1) Test each tool shortcut and Ctrl/Cmd+Z / Shift+Z
Expected Result: Each shortcut triggers the documented action; no conflict with browser shortcuts

Title: Keyboard-only navigation and focus order
Steps: 1) Tab through toolbar and panels
Expected Result: Logical focus order, visible focus ring, every control reachable and operable

Title: Contrast and accessible labels
Steps: 1) Inspect toolbar buttons and text
Expected Result: Buttons have accessible names; text contrast meets WCAG AA (4.5:1)

Title: 1,000 objects stay responsive
Steps: 1) Pan and zoom 2) Select all 3) Move
Expected Result: Interaction stays smooth (no multi-second freezes); memory does not grow without bound

Title: Core flows across browsers
Steps: 1) Run draw, shape, undo, export smoke set in each
Expected Result: Same behavior and output in all browsers; differences logged as defects

Title: HiDPI / Retina sharpness
Steps: 1) Draw thin lines and text 2) Zoom screenshot
Expected Result: Lines and text are crisp, not blurry; export dimensions unaffected

Title: Window resize and responsive layout
Steps: 1) Resize window to narrow and wide 2) Rotate a tablet
Expected Result: Panels reflow or collapse sensibly; canvas stays usable; no overlapped controls

Title: Touch and stylus input
Steps: 1) Draw with finger and stylus 2) Pinch zoom
Expected Result: Input draws correctly; palm rejection and pinch zoom work; no page scroll while drawing
